profile.name: 整数编号任务规则
profile.description: 这是一个用于集群计算工作流的规则对象，而非物理实验设备。它按整数任务编号生成、发布和跟踪任务，常用于显微成像数据分析或配方型数据处理流程中的任务调度、完成状态管理与超时重试控制。
profile.description_en: This is a software workflow rule object rather than a physical laboratory device. It generates, releases, and tracks tasks indexed by integer IDs, and is used in cluster-based microscopy data analysis or recipe-style processing workflows for task scheduling, completion tracking, and timeout/retry handling.

registry.description: A rule which generates tasks based on a template
